## Installation gate

Record the assigned asset, exact target drive model/capacity, preserved files, approved installer, and firmware detection. The teacher must confirm any erase or partition choice.

Use the live session first to test display, keyboard, mouse, USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, sound, and storage visibility. After approval, install Xubuntu 26.04 LTS, apply approved updates, and verify CPU, RAM, storage, USB, sound, display, network, restart, and login.

::: {.callout-important title="Data safety"}
An erase-disk installation destroys data on the selected drive. Confirm the exact target and preserve required files before continuing.
:::

Xubuntu 26.04 LTS is the standard student desktop. Lubuntu 26.04 LTS is a teacher-selected fallback for exceptionally weak hardware. Ubuntu Server is reserved for a later dedicated SSH and systems-administration machine.

Official references: [Xubuntu 26.04 release and downloads](https://xubuntu.org/release/26.04/) and [Ubuntu bootable USB guidance](https://ubuntu.com/desktop/docs/en/latest/how-to/create-a-bootable-usb-stick/).
